panels.title: Temperaturverläufe (Physikalisch aktive Fühler F1, F2, F3, F4, F6, F7, F8)

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) as time, CASE WHEN temp_sensor_1 BETWEEN -25 AND 140 THEN temp_sensor_1 ELSE NULL END as 'F1 Kollektor', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_6 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_6 ELSE NULL END as 'F6 Speicher Oben', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_7 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_7 ELSE NULL END as 'F7 Puffer Mitte', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_3 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_3 ELSE NULL END as 'F3 Puffer Unten', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_2 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_2 ELSE NULL END as 'F2 Sekundär Vorlauf', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_4 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_4 ELSE NULL END as 'F4 Sekundär Rücklauf', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_8 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_8 ELSE NULL END as 'F8 Heizrücklauf' FROM measurements WHERE timestamp >= datetime($__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND timestamp <= datetime($__to/1000, 'unixepoch') ORDER BY timestamp ASC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) as time, CASE WHEN temp_sensor_1 BETWEEN -25 AND 140 THEN temp_sensor_1 ELSE NULL END as 'F1 Kollektor', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_6 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_6 ELSE NULL END as 'F6 Speicher Oben', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_7 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_7 ELSE NULL END as 'F7 Puffer Mitte', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_3 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_3 ELSE NULL END as 'F3 Puffer Unten', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_2 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_2 ELSE NULL END as 'F2 Sekundär Vorlauf', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_4 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_4 ELSE NULL END as 'F4 Sekundär Rücklauf', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_8 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_8 ELSE NULL END as 'F8 Heizrücklauf' FROM measurements WHERE timestamp >= datetime($__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND timestamp <= datetime($__to/1000, 'unixepoch') ORDER BY timestamp ASC

panels.title: Aktoren: Pumpen & Umschaltventile (A1, A2, A3, A)

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) as time, pump_speed_a1 as 'A1 Solarkreispumpe', pump_speed_a2 as 'A2 Sekundärpumpe', pump_speed_a3 as 'A3 Rücklaufanhebung Ventil', pump_speed_a as 'A Schichtladeventil' FROM measurements WHERE timestamp >= datetime($__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND timestamp <= datetime($__to/1000, 'unixepoch') ORDER BY timestamp ASC
